name: Pure Heart Chronicles
source:
Mayhem Roses is the strongest guild in the kingdom of Sears. Even though there are countless tales about how they have overcome the hardest dungeons and collected great treasures on their journeys, few people know them personally, though their name is well known by anyone calling himself an adventurer. However, recently they experienced a terrible loss in their last mission...

Our protagonist Quinn will join them, in order to find the mysterious forces of evil that loom over the kingdom, while at the same time getting closer to the girls of the guild and coming to know them better.

[Edited from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=48582]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
西尔斯王国最强的公会是“混乱玫瑰”。关于她们如何攻克最艰难的迷宫、在旅途中收集巨大宝藏，有无数传说流传；尽管每个自称冒险者的人都知道她们的名字，却很少有人真正了解她们。然而，她们最近在上一次任务中遭受惨重损失……

我们的主人公奎因将加入她们，寻找笼罩王国的神秘邪恶力量，同时接近公会中的女孩们，更深入地了解她们。

[改编自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=48582]LemmaSoft论坛[/url]]
